# axm agents add

Configure coding-agent harnesses and materialize installed extensions

## When to use

Configure coding-agent harnesses and materialize installed extensions

## Usage

```bash
axm agents add [flags] <id...>
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type   | Required | Description                                                    |
| ---- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id` | string | Yes      | Coding-agent ID(s) to configure, such as claude-code or cursor |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                          |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Add agents to project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--detected`    | boolean | No       | Add detected agents                                                                  |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Apply without confirmation                                                           |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Apply even if the plan has unresolved warnings                                       |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would change without applying                                              |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Add Cursor to this workspace**

```bash
axm agents add cursor
```

**Preview configuring multiple agents**

```bash
axm agents add cursor codex --preview
```

**Configure all detected agents**

```bash
axm agents add --detected
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
